_note: 2026-08-24: protect-secrets (Write/Edit guard) unwired per hackathon team decision — real credentials may now be written directly, including to .env. See docs/corrections/REGISTER.md for the log entry required by AGENTS.md Law 7. block-dangerous-shell and guard-secret-shell still guard Bash calls: block-dangerous-shell denies destructive commands and pipe-to-shell patterns; guard-secret-shell denies shell redirects/heredocs/tee writing into a secret-by-convention path, credential-shaped literals typed directly into a command, and git plumbing (add -f, update-index --skip-worktree/--assume-unchanged) used to smuggle a secret past .gitignore — so a secret typed into .env by Write/Edit still cannot be committed or piped out through Bash. Any internal error inside either remaining hook denies the call rather than allowing it. Setup: after cloning, run `git config core.hooksPath .githooks` once so this repository's own pre-commit and pre-push checks (secret scan, LAW-MANIFEST.sha256 verification, full-history pre-submit gate) are active — see SETUP.md.
